source.operator_confirmation: same physical one-star ball as PPQ002; same table, rigid body, world frame and ball-centre origin
source.ordering: numbered contiguous exports; each file excluded at both edges by 1.5s; no fit spans export boundaries
source.duplication_check: no identical matched-index tracked marker frames; geometric continuity at export boundaries

net_guard.scope: Conservative net-vicinity exclusion, not ground-truth impact classification; no net restitution fit.

validation.split: Final C3D part held out, first two files training; each file edge excludes 1.5s, never join flights across export boundaries

limitations: Position-only diagnostic; constant effective vertical acceleration per chain
Net vicinity and nonballistic intervals excluded; cannot label all real net impacts
Short hops amplify height and contact-time uncertainty; chain estimates not independent balls
Does not refit table tangential law or replace joint RK4 contact estimate

flight.method: 30s block bootstrap, 24 repeats, within one recording

contact.method: 30s block bootstrap, 150 repeats, within one recording

normal_position.method: 30s block bootstrap, 150 repeats, within one recording

uncertainty.scope: Within one recording only; bootstrap optimizer diagnostics were not individually captured, so percentile ranges are preliminary.

method_limits: Last-file contact holdout has only 5 spin-qualified / 6 position-only contacts
Only 7 whole-chain fits, no whole-chain samples in final file; 3 within-chain last-hop checks are not independent recordings
A 307mm held-out flight error remains; retained in reported scores, not removed after scoring
Position-only restitution is about 0.9616, whole-chain median about 0.938, joint model about 0.9533; estimator and regime sensitivity remains
Mass, true ball-shell material elasticity, spin decay, paddle and net laws are not identified
Same physical one-star ball as PPQ002; no star-grade comparison is supported
recommendation: Retain current deployment pending stronger independent contact validation; candidate offers small mixed holdout changes, not a demonstrated overall improvement.
